name: Helambu Trek
sub_region: Sindhupalchok and Nuwakot Districts (Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park and southern Langtang National Park), Bagmati Province

difficulty.notes: Easy-to-moderate; mostly below about 2,700 m, high point Tharepati (approx. 3,640-3,690 m). Daily walks of about 3-7 hours. [s4, s5, s6]

duration_days.basis: Kathmandu to Kathmandu (start on foot at Sundarijal, finish by road from Melamchi Pul Bazaar)
duration_days.notes: 5-day express version (Chisapani - Tharepati in one day) involves a fast altitude gain; 6-day version avoids sleeping at Tharepati (Magen Goth instead); 8-day version adds Ama Yangri (approx. 3,771 m). Short 3-4 day options drive to Tarkeghyang/Sermathang. Can link to Gosainkunda via Laurebina La (see langtang-gosainkunda-trek). [s4, s5, s6]

start_point: Sundarijal (approx. 1,460 m), about 1 hour by road from central Kathmandu
end_point: Melamchi Pul Bazaar (approx. 850-870 m), then drive to Kathmandu

itinerary.route: Kathmandu - Sundarijal (drive), trek through Shivapuri Nagarjun NP to Chisapani
itinerary.notes: Chisapani given as 2,165-2,215 m. Shivapuri NP fee paid at Sundarijal. [s4, s5, s6]
Six-day versions sleep at Magen Goth (approx. 3,300 m) and cross Tharepati by day. [s5, s6]
Tarkeghyang given as 2,560-2,743 m. [s4, s5, s6]

itinerary.route: Sermathang - Melamchi Pul Bazaar, drive to Kathmandu

best_seasons.notes: During the Aug-Oct 2026 Rasuwa road closure, TAAN promoted the Sundarijal - Helambu route as an alternative access to Gosainkunda and Langtang. [s7]

permits.name: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park entry permit
permits.fee: NPR 1,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 600; Nepali NPR 100; under 10 free)

permits.name: Langtang National Park entry permit (upper Helambu, e.g. Kutumsang - Tharepati - Melamchi Gaon)
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued e-TIMS)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Helambu Trek is on NTB's mandatory guide + TIMS list

guide_requirements: NTB lists Helambu Trek under the revised TIMS provision effective 31 March 2023: licensed trekking guide and agency-issued TIMS card required. [s2]

drives: Melamchi Pul Bazaar - Kathmandu: approx. 2-3 hours
logistics.notes: No flight and no long drive needed - the nearest multi-day Himalayan trek to Kathmandu. Langtang NP checkpoints on the Helambu side are reported at Kutumsang, Mangengoth and Bhotang. [s4, s8]

highlights: Starts on foot from the edge of Kathmandu through Shivapuri Nagarjun NP
Hyolmo (Helambu Sherpa) villages, monasteries and apple orchards in Tarkeghyang and Sermathang
Himalayan panorama from Chisapani and Tharepati (Langtang, Jugal, Dorje Lakpa)
Low altitude, good for short trips and first-time trekkers
risks: Mild altitude at Tharepati (approx. 3,640 m), especially on the 5-day itinerary

acclimatization.notes: No dedicated acclimatization day needed on the standard itinerary; the 5-day version gains about 1,400 m in one day. [s6]

unverified: Tharepati altitude varies between 3,640 m and 3,690 m; Tarkeghyang between 2,560 m and 2,743 m.
